desc:
Start with $50,000 and grow it into a business empire worth billions! 📈 Corporate: Business Empire is a business simulator and tycoon game where you run a real company, trade on the stock market and race to become the richest CEO on Roblox.

🏭 Open factories, stores, media and real estate in 5 world regions
🔗 Make your own products and sell them in your own stores
📦 Sign wholesale contracts with retailers
🔬 Unlock R&D upgrades that boost your whole company
🏛️ Found subsidiaries and buy out rival companies
🔔 Take your company public (IPO) and sell shares to other players
📊 Trade stocks, build a portfolio and earn dividends
🏆 Climb a global leaderboard across every server

💤 Your businesses keep making money while you're offline. Claim your daily bonus, finish goals for cash rewards and go from startup to billionaire!

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite to get every update!
